verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an "Advanced search" that filters items by many properties, and its API can list items filtered by level and environment. Version tracking shows which code versions throw errors, which touches release filtering. The evidence is thin and covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: a documented query syntax/grammar, cross-project search, filtering by tags and custom properties, explicit release/version filters in search, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
